Definition: A control that shows one month. A person picks a date by choosing one of its days.
A text field for a date, with a button that opens a calendar below it. A person can type the date or choose it.
The Quorum class for a day on the calendar: a year, a month and a day, with no time of day.
The way a date is written as text, such as "March 12, 2027" or "03/12/2027". A DateFormat object holds one.
The day in a calendar that the arrow keys are on. It has a ring around it while the calendar has the focus.
How exact a piece of data is. A date is precise to the day. A time can be precise to the minute or the second.
An object that a control tells when something happens. A CalendarListener is told when a person chooses a date.
